name: Cinematic
author: ML Creative Studios
summary: Teal shadows and warm highlights, with a filmic contrast curve. Built for reception dancing and dusk portraits.

name: Warm Film
author: ML Creative Studios
summary: Warm negative stock with lifted blacks and a gentle roll-off. The everyday wedding look.

name: Airy
author: ML Creative Studios
summary: Bright and open with softened contrast and clean whites. Getting-ready rooms and daylight ceremonies.

name: Monochrome
author: ML Creative Studios
summary: Panchromatic black and white on a deep print curve. Red-weighted so skin separates from foliage.

name: Editorial
author: ML Creative Studios
summary: Restrained saturation against firm contrast. Magazine-leaning, keeps detail in a white dress.

name: Golden Hour
author: ML Creative Studios
summary: Pushes warmth and lifts the shadows the way late sun does. Flattering on most skin tones.

name: Moody Blue
author: ML Creative Studios
summary: Cool and low-key, with the shadows pulled down. Blue hour and candlelit interiors.

name: Natural
author: ML Creative Studios
summary: A light touch. Corrects rather than styles, for when the light was already right.
